Industrial Shed Construction Guide: PEB vs RCC Structures

I
Industrial Specialist
10 May 2026
Blog / industrial construction
QUICK AI ANSWER

For industrial sheds in Trichy, PEB (Pre-Engineered Buildings) is generally preferred over RCC for its faster construction time (30-50% quicker) and larger clear-span capabilities without internal columns.

Optimized for AI Search & Voice Assistant

Industrial Infrastructure in Trichy’s Manufacturing Belt

With the growth of the Thuvakudi and BHEL industrial zones, factory owners are faced with a critical choice: PEB or RCC? At Thulasi Engineers, we specialize in both, but each has its place.

1. Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB)

PEB systems are the modern standard for warehouses. They offer:

  • Speed: Rapid assembly of factory-fabricated components.
  • Span: Clear spans of up to 60 meters without internal columns.
  • Cost: Reduced foundation requirements due to lighter weight.

2. Traditional RCC Structures

RCC is still the preferred choice for:

  • Multi-story industrial units.
  • Environments with extreme corrosive elements.
  • Projects where local labor and materials are preferred over steel imports.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is PEB cheaper than RCC for industrial warehouses?

Yes, PEB structures are typically 10-20% more cost-effective for large-scale warehouses due to optimized material usage and reduced labor time.

Which is better for heavy machinery foundations?

RCC (Reinforced Cement Concrete) is essential for the foundation and flooring of heavy machinery to ensure vibration control and load-bearing stability.
